answer: Each identity files one vine-yard nectar barrel for one voyage. It posts an 80-credit bond and files a sealed barrel's stave length, head diameter, and bulge diameter. The auditor recomputes volume with a public cooperage table; a gap over 1% against nectar volume burns the bond and voids the identity. The k-th fee is 34+6(k-1): the 1000th pays 6028, and 1000 fakes pay 3,031,000 plus 80,000 in bonds. A rented-barrel ring fails: a broken seal cannot reseal another barrel, and duplicate seals expose reuse. An honest agent pays one fee and one bond per vine barrel, recovered on voyage arrival.
